searchText: Pectra going live in <1h 😄 If you need to upgrade your node, this is your final reminder: https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/04/23/pectra-mainnet You can follow the fork along here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NbxaCZYtW-I Pectra has gone live and finalized 🎉 ! Testing of the newly activated EIPs continues. The EF's testing team has tested all the Pectra EIPs in prod 🫡 Congrats, everyone, Pectra is live 🦒 https://x.com/elbuenmayini/status/1920082396625375387 Consensus layer specs v1.5.0 -- Pikachu -- released! https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.5.0 Test vectors: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/tag/v1.5.0
